name: TwistingData.pow_dvd_coeff_conj_frobOperator
summary: Apply frobOperator_mem with the w-adic Gauss filtration on O[x] for weights ω built from the index weights (scaled by ε/2·P^m/q, ε the sign of the quantity in g), α(s, d, b) = A(d + (s − d − i) mod N, b) and x = ε/2·excessWeight(i + ℓ). The hypothesis H on the entries of ψ(s, d) holds because ψ(s, d) ≡ X_{s−d}^{(P^d)} modulo p = w² (p_dvd_cj_frobenius_sub). The resulting level, compared through e and g with c, exceeds c, and N·n·k(ℓ+2)u ≤ 1/2 by hn.

steps.claim: Substitute ψ (hψ), record p ≠ 0 and 1 ≤ P, and choose ε with |ε| = 1 and |Δ| = ε·Δ for the quantity Δ in g, so that 2c + 1 < ε·Δ.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨rfl, _, _, ε, hε, g⟩ := hψ, T.prime.ne_zero, T.one_lt_P.le,
    (RCLike.exists_norm_eq_mul_self _).imp fun _ ↦ And.imp_right g.trans_eq

steps.claim: Let A(m, b) = indexWeight T ℓ a a' b·(ε/2)·P^m/q, and weights ω of the generic variables: ω(j, b, c) = A(N, b) if j = i, and A((j − i) mod N, b) − A((j − i) mod N, c) otherwise.
steps.lean:
let A m b := T.indexWeight ℓ a a' b * (ε / 2 * T.P ^ m / T.q)
  let ω | (j, b, c) => ite (j = i) (A N b) (A (j - i).val b - A (j - i).val c)
